scripts.build:offline: npm run generate && node tools/python-cmd.cjs tools/build.py
scripts.build:sites: npm run generate && node tools/python-cmd.cjs deploy/chatgpt-sites/build.py
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler dev --config deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && npx wrangler deploy --config deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.json
scripts.test: node --test tests/navigation.test.cjs tests/presenter-ink.test.cjs tests/deck-tools.test.cjs tests/access-gate.test.mjs tests/build.test.mjs tests/selection.test.cjs tests/layouts.test.cjs tests/pptx-export.test.cjs
